typography.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace
typography.notes: Fraunces serif must be used for all expressive headings (e.g., 'A simple way to be reached'). Monospace must be used specifically for the live address field (`talk.kodama.page/your-name`). Inter for supporting explainer text. Avoid bolding everything; use Light or Regular weights for elegance.

light.notes: Light theme: Warm paper (#F4F1ED) background, deep evergreen foreground. Restrained use of ember/moss for accents.

dark.notes: Dark theme: Deep evergreen/dusk background, pale mist foreground.

layouts.strategy: One calm viewport. The container must occupy ~100vh with overflow-hidden or restrained scrolling. Focus heavily on negative space. The left side (or top on mobile) holds the Hero Headings + the Live Address Field. The right side (or bottom) houses the 3-beat explainer intertwined with the editorial DOM diagram.
layouts.viewport: min-h-[100dvh] w-full relative flex flex-col justify-center items-center py-12 px-6 overflow-hidden
layouts.grid_system: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 lg:gap-24 items-center z-10

fade_on_type.animation: explainer and diagram container -> opacity: 0, filter: blur(8px), transform: translateY(16px), pointer-events: none
fade_on_type.stagger: Fade out elements slightly staggered for organic feel.

hero_field.morphing: The live address field morphs in place. When status changes from idle, it should remain the primary focal point, slightly shifting up or centering. Do not trigger route changes.

background_treatment.image_layer: Use the provided misty pine forest image as an absolute positioned `object-cover` background with very low opacity (e.g., opacity-10 in dark, opacity-5 in light) to add atmospheric depth.
background_treatment.mist_gradients: Overlay radial gradients at the bottom and corners using the `--mist` color to soften edges and text areas.
background_treatment.grain: SVG noise filter or grain overlay covering the entire viewport with mix-blend-mode: overlay, opacity-20.

editorial_diagram.container: Relative container acting as the visual anchor for the explainer.
editorial_diagram.drop_cards: Three small div 'cards' (bg-card), rotated slightly (e.g., -6deg, 0deg, 6deg), overlapping each other, absolute positioned. Subtle borders, shadow-sm.
editorial_diagram.arrows: Dotted SVG paths (`stroke-dasharray='4 4'`) connecting the drop cards to the address field or main flow.
editorial_diagram.address_card: A larger card representing the 'YOUR TALK ADDRESS' that encloses the actual live input field.
editorial_diagram.timeline: A minimalist vertical timeline using thin left borders (`border-l border-moss/30`) and small glowing dots to represent: 'Drop left -> Received -> Replied -> Private Talk'.

mist_background.description: Green pine trees covered with fog. MUST be used as an ultra-low opacity atmospheric layer behind everything.

accessibility.focus_states: The live address field MUST have a high-contrast focus ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring`).
accessibility.contrast: Keep the misty background extremely subtle so the text maintains APCA minimum contrast ratios.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion animations to disable blur/translation and just use simple opacity crossfades if `prefers-reduced-motion` is true.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the landing screen in a single file or a few tightly coupled components within `/app/frontend/src/`. No Shadcn components are strictly required for the custom layout, but standard HTML/Tailwind works best for the editorial feel.
Set up the `--background`, `--foreground`, and other color variables in your CSS root and dark classes.

The hero section is essentially a large input. As the user types in the monospace field, simulate the `status` state changing from `idle` to `checking` -> `available`/`yours`. This state change MUST trigger the Framer Motion fade-out of the explainer and diagram.
Do NOT build generic 'SaaS dashboard' cards. The explainer should look like editorial text (Fraunces + Inter).

Recreate the editorial diagram entirely with DOM nodes (HTML/Tailwind/Framer). It should consist of little note 'Drop' cards pointing via SVG paths to the address field, and a small conversation timeline trail.
In the diagram, text should be calm and minimal: 'A Drop (no account needed)' -> 'You decide' -> 'It stays yours'.
Never use encryption or security jargon. Maintain the 'quiet forest doorway' tone.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Always add `data-testid` attributes to interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid='live-address-input'`, `data-testid='explainer-section'`).
Do NOT center align everything. Embrace asymmetry and grid spans (e.g., col-span-5 for hero, col-span-6 for diagram).
Ensure padding is generous. Use `p-12` or `p-24` on desktop, `p-6` on mobile.
Do not use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `opacity transform`.
Avoid default AI-slop gradients (no purples/neons). Strictly adhere to the Kodama color variables.
Use Framer Motion (`<motion.div>`) for the fade_on_type mechanics.
